name: call-booking
description: Сервис бронирования встреч по мотивам Cal.com

scripts.setup: npm install && npm run generate && hk install
scripts.generate: npm run api:build && npm run client:generate
scripts.dev: npm run generate && concurrently -n server,web -c green,magenta "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.build: npm run generate && npm run build --workspace server && npm run build --workspace web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace server && npm run typecheck --workspace web
scripts.check: npm run generate && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build --workspace server && npm run build --workspace web
